subject: math
question: 计算积分 $\int \frac{\sin 2x + \cos x}{2\sin^4 x + \cos^2 x + 7}\mathrm{d}x.$
answer: \begin{array}{l} = \frac {2}{3 \sqrt {7}} \arctan \frac {4 \sin^ {2} x - 1}{3 \sqrt {7}} + \frac {\sqrt {1 4}}{5 6} \arctan \frac {\sqrt {1 4}}{7} \left(\sin x - \frac {2}{\sin x}\right) + \\ \frac {\sqrt {2}}{4 8} \ln \frac {\sin x + \frac {2}{\sin x} + \frac {3 \sqrt {2}}{2}}{\sin x + \frac {2}{\sin x} - \frac {3 \sqrt {2}}{2}} + C. \end{array}

steps.text: 分析 被积函数属于 $R(\sin x, -\cos x) = -R(\sin x, \cos x)$ 型，宜作变量代换 $\sin x = t$ 。

$$
\begin{array}{r l} I & = \int \frac {2 \sin x + 1}{2 \sin^ {4} x - \sin^ {2} x + 8} \mathrm{d} \sin x \stackrel {t = \sin x} {=} \int \frac {2 t + 1}{2 t ^ {4} - t ^ {2} + 8} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \int \frac {1}{2 t ^ {4} - t ^ {2} + 8} \mathrm{d} t ^ {2} + \frac {1}{4} \int \frac {t ^ {2} + 2}{2 t ^ {4} - t ^ {2} + 8} \mathrm{d} t - \frac {1}{4} \int \frac {t ^ {2} - 2}{2 t ^ {4} - t ^ {2} + 8} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \frac {2}{3 \sqrt {7}} \arctan \frac {4 t ^ {2} - 1}{3 \sqrt {7}} + \frac {1}{8} \int \frac {1 + 2 / t ^ {2}}{(t - 2 / t) ^ {2} + 7 / 2} \mathrm{d} t + \frac {1}{8} \int \frac {1 - 2 / t ^ {2}}{9 / 2 - (t + 2 / t) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \frac {2}{3 \sqrt {7}} \arctan \frac {4 t ^ {2} - 1}{3 \sqrt {7}} + \frac {1}{8} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (t - 2 / t)}{(t - 2 / t) ^ {2} + 7 / 2} + \frac {1}{8} \int \frac {\mathrm{d} (t - 2 / t)}{9 / 2 - (t + 2 / t) ^ {2}} \end{array}

\begin{array}{l} = \frac {2}{3 \sqrt {7}} \arctan \frac {4 \sin^ {2} x - 1}{3 \sqrt {7}} + \frac {\sqrt {1 4}}{5 6} \arctan \frac {\sqrt {1 4}}{7} \left(\sin x - \frac {2}{\sin x}\right) + \\ \frac {\sqrt {2}}{4 8} \ln \frac {\sin x + \frac {2}{\sin x} + \frac {3 \sqrt {2}}{2}}{\sin x + \frac {2}{\sin x} - \frac {3 \sqrt {2}}{2}} + C. \end{array}
$$

solution.final_answer: \begin{array}{l} = \frac {2}{3 \sqrt {7}} \arctan \frac {4 \sin^ {2} x - 1}{3 \sqrt {7}} + \frac {\sqrt {1 4}}{5 6} \arctan \frac {\sqrt {1 4}}{7} \left(\sin x - \frac {2}{\sin x}\right) + \\ \frac {\sqrt {2}}{4 8} \ln \frac {\sin x + \frac {2}{\sin x} + \frac {3 \sqrt {2}}{2}}{\sin x + \frac {2}{\sin x} - \frac {3 \sqrt {2}}{2}} + C. \end{array}

cdps.expected: 按被积函数类型选标准变形或代换，化为可积的基本形式。
